before.description: ISO 8601 timestamp cursor. When provided, returns messages created before this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Default 30, max 100.

message_id.description: Exact persisted message ID to resolve, such as a message_id returned in search_memory source_refs.

session_id.description: Session ID to read. Defaults to the current session when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return. Default 50.

platform.description: Filter by channel platform (e.g. telegram, feishu). Returns all platforms when omitted.

type.description: Filter by session type: chat or schedule. Returns all types when omitted.

contact_id.description: Filter by sender channel identity ID.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Only return messages created at or before this time.

keyword.description: Search keyword — matches against the text content of messages (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Default 50, max 200.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Only return messages created at or after this time.
